item.title: Health alert issued for dengue outbreaks spreading in travel hotspots

item.summary: Israel is fighting on two fronts in the Iran conflict, but Hugh Hewitt argues Americans remain largely unaware of their ally's contributions to the war.

item.title: TSA warns of 'longstanding' shutdown fallout even after funding clears, and a major event could make it worse
item.summary: TSA Deputy Administrator Adam Stahl warns the shutdown's impacts will be "longstanding'" with 480+ officers quitting and record-high airport security wait times reported.

item.title: Jayapal doubles down on anti-ICE terror claims as DHS shutdown triggers historic travel chaos

item.title: Key Trump agency unleashes probe on blue state over potential race-based mortgage aid: 'DEI is dead'
item.summary: HUD has opened a fair housing investigation into Washington state’s Covenant Homeownership Program, arguing public materials suggest the aid may unlawfully rely on race-based eligibility requirements.

item.title: Yankees make MLB history as Aaron Judge strikes out four times on Opening Day
item.summary: New York Yankees slugger Aaron Judge had an awful game, but the team was still able to make history in their 7-0 victory over the San Francisco Giants.

item.title: America's $39 trillion debt bomb could be more painful than you think
